intro.text: An elder and teacher in the Village, Elendel's Terris enclave.

items.text: Around 314 PC, Tellingdwar instructed young Terris pupils in the old traditions, and one evening gave a recitation on Preservation and metal. When fifteen-year-old Asinthew, as Wax was known there, asked about violence in the Village, Tellingdwar told him of a couple he had known: fifteen years before, the husband shot his wife with a gun of unknown origin. The Terris, he said, were no better than other people.
He was one of the Terris who found the gruesome aftermath when Wax had no choice but to kill Forch.

appearance.text: Short, with a shaved head and bright yellow and orange robes in the traditional style of a Terris steward.

personality.text: Peaceable, frank and steeped in Terris tradition, with a steward's habit of turning any conversation into a lesson. Vwafendal relies on his reports of Asinthew's progress.
